verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a data-export doc that says Metronome can send both "sandbox and production data" to a warehouse, which implies a separate sandbox environment exists. Nothing describes how to provision it, authenticate to it, or test API and agent workflows against it in isolation. missing for 10: documentation of sandbox setup and access, sandbox-specific API tokens or endpoints, an explicit guarantee of data isolation from production, guidance on test workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
